title: Left rail, open: the mark, seven nav items every 60 units with the current plate, a tool capsule, the dark go block and the share row
use: The fixed left navigation of a site in this grammar, drawn open (270 wide; it is 90 wide closed). current moves the plate.
relations: Items every 60 units from y 152; the current plate 252 x 60 (78 closed) with a 9-unit ink bar.
Tool capsule at y 680, go block at y 848, share row at y 912: the bottom group is fixed, not spaced to fit.
decoration: The datum mark, item icons, tool icons, share dots: drawn.
